title: Oracle C2M Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Isolate and fix C2M failures — fast, with root cause
problem: When C2M breaks, the cause hides across WebLogic, the database, the network, and the application. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for Oracle C2M and WebLogic 14c — startup/login failures, batch and JMS problems, IWS/integration errors, performance stalls, and outages — so you isolate the failing layer, restore service, and produce a defensible root-cause analysis.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M fault domains (WebLogic, database, network, application/OUAF) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (log/metric access, WLST, SQL, environment access) with how to verify each.

Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom-driven tree (won't start / can't log in; batch fails; JMS backs up; IWS/integration errors; performance stall; outage) with the exact checks per branch and the layer each isolates.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each gate to the fix and to service restoration, plus Best Practices for defensible RCA and escalation to Oracle.
short: A structured root-cause tree and diagnostic scripts for Oracle C2M + WebLogic 14c — startup/login, batch, JMS, IWS, performance, outages — to isolate the failing layer, restore service, and produce a defensible RCA. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
